
## Summary

**Standardize the operator status card** (residual after DUX5)

Primary words occupy entire panels without reason, impact or action.

## Priority / wave

- Priority: **P1**
- Wave: **V2**
- Complexity: **L**
- Audit code: `UX-P1-02`
- DUX code: `DUX6-11`

## Scope

Overview, Pipeline Diagnostics, Provider Health, Data Quality, Incident Workspace, Trust.

Screenshot groups: status-dominant boards

## Concrete change

Create a library card: Status badge, primary statement, reason, impact, action, freshness/source. Use neutral surface and colored strip/icon.

## Expected effect

Faster recognition and less color saturation.

## Acceptance criteria

- Each first-screen status has state + reason + action; supporting text remains visible; full-color backgrounds reserved for critical state.
- Live/screenshot evidence at 1366×768 (blocking) after change
- No new high-cardinality Prometheus labels
- No hidden verdict logic only in Grafana transforms

## Dependencies

Status semantics and shared library-panel governance.

## Risk

Over-standardization may reduce domain nuance; allow optional fields.

## Predecessor / residual notes

#7124 DUX5-11 closed — residual: Status still occupies full surface vs card

## Constraints

- Surgical dashboard JSON; preserve panel IDs where possible
- Prefer description/runbook for caveats; first-screen ≤2–4 lines
- Tech-debt budgets non-increasing

## Verification

- [ ] Before/after screenshots (dark)
- [ ] Viewports 1366/1440/1920 @100% (125% if layout-sensitive)
- [ ] Targeted pytest if JSON structure changes
- [ ] 5-second operator comprehension on first-screen card

## Parent

DUX6 epic (#7139)
